summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement of a routine grant of conditional share awards under the HSBC Share Plan 2011. On 4 November 2026 the company granted awards over 336,726 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each to employees and former employees at a purchase price of GBP 0, with the London closing price GBP 13.182 on the grant date. Vesting runs over three years (33%/33%/34%), with longer periods for Material Risk Takers, 12-month retention, clawback and buy-out provisions. No special-situation element; watch only dilution capacity under plan limits.
